title: Italian prime minister on the church–state–mafia triumvirate

tellings.quote: Okay? So yes, there was a triumpvirate that ran Italy for a long time and it was an alliance of the pope, the Vatican, the elected government and the cityian market.

plain: In Rome in 1973, the prime minister of Italy told Harald Malmgren, an American economic adviser to several presidents, that Italy had long been run by a three-way alliance of the Pope and the Vatican, the elected government, and the Sicilian mafia. Malmgren tells Michels he heard it firsthand, and names Pete Peterson, a US official of the time, in the story. If true, it shows how hidden power could sit behind a modern democracy.
